text:
sam_b: Quick sync on Acme Health acceptance criteria — ran perf yesterday, sharing summary and asks below.

rick_sales: great, need the numbers for the pricing conversation.

elaine_eng: Uploading short summary: ran 10k sample requests, ramp to 150->200 RPS over 30m. Median 120ms, p95 420ms, p99 ~1.4s. Tail spikes during a GC window and when cache warmed cold.

deepa_infra: Noted cache churn. We saw ~20% extra latency from KV cache misses during the ramp. Recommend increasing model KV cache to 8GB or enabling prefix caching for their common prefixes.

jules_sre: Re-ran a quick fallback test — when we auto-fallback to the smaller quantized variant median drops to ~90ms but quality diffs appear on their eval set. Worth discussing tradeoff with product.

sam_b: Customer requirement: sustain 150 RPS with p95 < 500ms. Pricing ask from them: committed reservation vs on-demand — need monthly estimate and recommended committed size.

rick_sales: Can we get a ballpark reserved vs on-demand number to share in the call later today?

elaine_eng: Ballpark: a dedicated pool sized for that workload maps to ~3x A10g-equivalent workers -> approx $42k/month reserved. On-demand/hosted expected to be ~55-65% higher for same throughput during sustained load. I'll attach a breakdown.

deepa_infra: Ops note: queue sizing matters here. We saw request queuing hit SLO briefly at peak spikes. Suggest recommended_queue = peak_rps * 1.25 * avg_latency_seconds (we used this formula in the run).

jules_sre: Also validated canary fallback policy: if primary model latency > 800ms for 30s, route 20% to fallback. That kept error rate low during simulated injector faults.

sam_b: Also flagged: security questionnaire had a few blockers — data residency and KMS integration are still unanswered. That blocks acceptance for their legal.

security_bot: Reminder: Security questionnaire submitted 2025-03-12. Pending items: data residency (EU-only), KMS/BYOK options, log retention specifics.

rick_sales: @sam_b anything we need from sales to move security/finance?

sam_b: Please send the customer's formal reservation ask (rps, expected tokens) and I'll propose a 2-week acceptance window and a canary rollout.

frank_finance: cc'ing finance — send committed rps and expected token burn. For a 12-month commit, we can draft a tiered discount; need numbers to size it.

elaine_eng: Attaching the perf command we used for reproducibility: ```
hey-load --target-url https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate --rps 200 --duration 1800 --concurrency 50 --model redwood-v1
```

jules_sre: Run artifacts (internal): https://redwood.app/artefacts/1965439999/perf-report.html — has latency heatmaps, raw samples, and the error traces. TL;DR included in the report.

deepa_infra: Ops actions: I'll enable prefix caching on the test pool and bump KV cache to 8GB, then re-run a 20m smoke at 160 RPS (ETA ~6h).

sam_b: Draft acceptance criteria for review: p95 <= 500ms, error rate < 0.5%, semantic eval pass rate >= 95% on Acme's reference set, and security questionnaire items resolved.

rick_sales: I'll confirm reservation interest with Acme and push for a 12-month commit.

frank_finance: Once you have projected monthly commit we can run the discount bands. Please include expected steady-state RPS and peak.

elaine_eng: I'll prepare the pricing and unit-cost breakdown and share by EOD tomorrow. Also can provide the smaller-model fallback perf delta.

security_bot: Security note: KMS/BYOK requires Private deployment or Dedicated VPC for standard integrations. Will add that to the questionnaire reply; ETA 2 business days.

rick_sales: Thanks team — will follow up with Acme after I get the reservation numbers. :thumbsup:
